dismembered_arm.name: Dismembered Arm
dismembered_arm.effect: Arm lost; anything held in it is dropped.

dismembered_hand.name: Dismembered Hand
dismembered_hand.effect: Hand lost; anything held in it is dropped.

broken_ribs.name: Broken Ribs
broken_ribs.effect: At the end of each turn in which you moved more than 4 m on foot, you take bonus damage to HP.

broken_arm.name: Broken Arm
broken_arm.effect: The arm is unusable; anything held in it is dropped.

foreign_object_body.name: Foreign Object
foreign_object_body.effect: At the end of each turn in which you moved more than 4 m on foot, you take bonus damage to HP.

spinal_injury.name: Spinal Injury
spinal_injury.effect: On your next turn you can only move.

crushed_fingers.name: Crushed Fingers
crushed_fingers.effect: −4 to all actions involving that hand.

dismembered_leg.name: Dismembered Leg
dismembered_leg.effect: −6 to MOVE (minimum 1); you cannot dodge attacks.

lost_eye.name: Lost Eye
lost_eye.effect: −4 to ranged attacks and Perception checks that rely on sight.

damaged_eye.name: Damaged Eye
damaged_eye.effect: −2 to ranged attacks and Perception checks that rely on sight.

foreign_object_head.name: Foreign Object
foreign_object_head.effect: At the end of each turn in which you moved more than 4 m on foot, you take bonus damage to HP.

cracked_skull.name: Cracked Skull
cracked_skull.effect: Aimed head shots multiply the damage that gets through by 3 instead of 2.

damaged_ear.name: Damaged Ear
damaged_ear.effect: If you moved more than 4 m on foot in your turn, you cannot move next turn; −2 to Perception checks that rely on hearing.

lost_ear.name: Lost Ear
lost_ear.effect: As Damaged Ear, but −4 to Perception checks that rely on hearing.
